source.author: verg
source.text: At non audaci Turno fiducia cessit; ultro animos tollit dictis atque increpat ultro:
source.text_original: At non audaci Turno fiducia cessit; / ultro animos tollit dictis atque increpat ultro: /
source.text_english: But courage did not fail bold Turnus; rather, he himself raises their spirits with words and chides them in turn:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: talibus Alcimede maeret; sed fortior Aeson attollens dictis animos:
reuse.text_original: ' / talibus Alcimede maeret; sed fortior Aeson / attollens dictis animos:
reuse.text_english: Alcimede mourns in such words; but Aeson, braver, lifting their spirits with his words:
